# tenancy.CreateProjectInput

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Creates a project in an organization (`core.project.create` at the organization).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `tenancy.CreateProjectInput` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.project.create` |
